title: We'll repeat!

title: Very constructive visit. Makes you love wine more
text: It was a magnificent experience. Montse made a very interesting presentation, giving many tips and valuable information. The very pleasant and comfortable environment, conveys a lot of peace. Highly recommended
author: Maricarmen68

title: Great!
text: The visit to the vineyards and winery was very interesting. The girl who made it to us explained the whole process in an understandable and enjoyable way. The tasting was also interesting, as it accompanied her with a game to make the tasting more enjoyable and fun.
author: Sightsee33138273476

title: Excellent
text:
Excellent visit. The information provided was exceptional and the passion with which Montse relates it makes you not lose the thread for a moment. Very grateful to Montse for making the visit a very enriching experience for both palate and knowledge.
Our visit included food at a local restaurant and was also excellent. Service a 10.
author: isabelpM7818YV

title: Very pretty
text:
It was very nice... Filo is a very kind girl and the experience comes very nice!
I don't recommend the pack with lunch. Although the restaurant was local and I like that, the menu was closed and we couldn't choose, we think we paid a lot for what there was.

title: Interesting visit
text: Nestor the winemaker who made the visit and explanation conveyed his passion for wines and his entire history. The food a little expensive for what it is. I was hoping the farmhouse would be more rustic.
